title: Fiesta de Hogares en el Nuevo Año (New Year Housing Party)
names_seen: Fiesta de Hogares en el Nuevo Año (New Year Housing Party)

facts.statement: A community housing party event where players show off decorated homes or apartments, held on Friday 8 January 2010 on Server 1.
The event for US and Latin America was at 15:00 Pacific Time on Server 1.
facts.quote: 15hrs Tiempo Pacifico (U.S.A y Latino América) Servidor 1

facts.statement: The event for UK and Europe was at 09:00 Pacific Time (18:00 European time) on Server 1.
facts.quote: 0900hrs Tiempo Pacifico / 18hrs Tiempo Europeo (UK y Europa) Servidor 1

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language community event announcement on freerealms.com: players meet in Sanctuary to visit each other's decorated homes and share decorating tips, for a Friday 8 January 2010 event on Server 1 held at two times for different regions. It gives the meeting point and the rule that you must be on a friend's list to visit their home. The article's own posting date is unclear (it shows only a relative age, '1 year, 4 months ago').
